denial.payer_remark: Required modifier missing, or modifier inconsistent with the procedure.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-05-13
Patient: 65-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: knee pain
History: osteoarthritis of the knee; pain worse on stairs.
Examination: crepitus and a small effusion.
Procedure: knee aspirated and injected with corticosteroid.
Plan: review in six weeks.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-05-13.

missing_evidence: dated addendum from the treating clinician stating which knee was injected
expected.rationale: A side modifier is required, but the note never says which knee and the diagnosis code is the unspecified-side one. The policy forbids guessing: an addendum from the clinician comes first.
